raw:
@q query
  where all
    match
      relation "come"
      role subject "Iulian"
      role time "tomorrow"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "work"
      role object "the night shift"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end

@q2 query
  where match
    relation "replace"
    role subject ?x
    role object "Iulian"
    role time "tomorrow"
    polarity affirmed
  end
